notice.title: Liquidity stress testing
notice.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions with over 1 billion in assets must run monthly liquidity stress tests including rapid digital deposit outflow scenarios and hold enough liquid assets to cover 30 days of net outflows under their most severe scenario. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions with more than 1 billion in total assets, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution with 18 billion in total assets.

text:
PRUDENTIAL BANKING BOARD FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Liquidity stress testing
Notice number: RCN-2026-015
Issued by: Prudential Banking Board
Published: 2026-10-23
Effective date: 2027-03-31
1. Who this applies to
Deposit-taking institutions with more than 1 billion in total assets.
2. Background
Recent deposit outflows moved faster than many firms had assumed. Stress tests must reflect how quickly digital deposits can leave.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must run liquidity stress tests at least monthly, including a scenario with rapid outflows of digital deposits.
3.2 A firm must hold enough liquid assets to cover the net outflows of its most severe stress scenario for at least 30 days.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-03-31.

obligations.text: A firm must run liquidity stress tests at least monthly, including a scenario with rapid outflows of digital deposits.
obligations.controlDesc: Monthly liquidity stress test results, including the digital outflow scenario, reviewed by ALCO
obligations.reason: Policy POL-LIQ-01 states "Liquidity stress tests run monthly and include a rapid digital deposit outflow scenario" which exactly matches the obligation's frequency (at least monthly) and scope (including rapid digital deposit outflows), and Control CTL-211 ensures "Monthly liquidity stress test results, including the digital outflow scenario, reviewed by ALCO" which would detect any failure to run the required tests.

obligations.text: A firm must hold enough liquid assets to cover the net outflows of its most severe stress scenario for at least 30 days.
obligations.controlDesc: Daily check that liquid assets cover 30 days of net outflows in the most severe scenario
obligations.reason: Policy POL-LIQ-01 states "The bank holds liquid assets sufficient to cover net outflows in its most severe scenario for at least 30 days" and Control CTL-212 performs a daily check that liquid assets cover 30 days of net outflows in the most severe scenario, which would detect any breach of the 30-day coverage requirement.
